entities.name: Neolithic Revolution Period
entities.label: Timeframe
entities.summary: The period (c. 10,000-3,000 BCE) when humans transitioned from nomadic hunting-gathering to settled agricultural communities, independently in at least seven world regions. This "first economic revolution" — domesticating plants and animals — enabled population growth, permanent settlements, social stratification, craft specialization, and eventually cities, states, and writing.
